_meta.deck: SkipWait goal UI: shared copy deck and preview fixtures
_meta.decision: D-048: key-screen designs go to the owner before any rollout.
_meta.use: Every direction renders exactly this copy and data, so the comparison is purely visual. Do not add, reword or drop visible strings. aria-labels may be added where an element needs one. Items marked rendered:false define behaviour and are not drawn in the three comps.
_meta.status: Design-review preview only. Sample data, never product data (the D-001 rule that D-048 keeps).
_meta.previewToday: 2026-10-18 (Sunday). Every relative day count below is computed from this date.
_meta.dates: Day-level only, written D MMM (17 Oct), set in mono with tabular numerals. No hours, minutes or seconds anywhere.
_meta.companies: Fictional names, so no preview implies that a real company has verified referrers on SkipWait. Live on 17 Oct: 39 companies listed, 1 open.
_meta.money: Money lines follow what the code does today (client/src/pages/Help.tsx line 13). D-034, D-035, D-038 and D-047 are approved but not built, so no comp shows their outcomes.
_meta.privacy: Before acceptance a referrer sees the role, job function, job link, the three reasons, ask-quality checks, a day-level clock and a document count. Never the seeker's name, file names, links, photo or plan.
_meta.noMetrics: No per-referrer numbers anywhere: no response rates, speeds, rankings, streaks or counts of referrers. No read receipts. Exception (D-104): the company responsiveness signal shows company-level aggregates only, min 3, never per person or ranked.
_meta.typography: Copy uses typographic apostrophes (’), the true minus sign (−), the en dash (–), the middle dot (·) and the ellipsis character (…). Keep them.

stepper.rules: Steps before stage are done, the step at stage is current, later steps are upcoming. A Referred ask shows all four done and the Referred node is the only emerald one. An ended ask keeps its reached steps, then shows its terminal mark (Expired in crimson, Withdrawn in muted ink) in place of the next step; later steps stay upcoming and muted.

companySignal.intro: What askers can expect here – from real activity, updated monthly.
companySignal.disclaimer: Averages only, never a ranking, never for sale. Numbers come from what referrers actually do – a company cannot buy a better one. If there is too little activity to be honest, we show “Not enough data yet” instead.

claimCompany.label: For companies

benefits.title: A public signal you earn
benefits.body: Your responsiveness shows on your company page once 3+ employees and 3+ answered asks qualify. Never for sale, never a ranking.

claimCompany.privacy: No seeker names. No resumes. No individual referrer stats. Companies see aggregates - people stay people, not leads.
claimCompany.fine: We email a verification link to your work email. Claiming is free. There is nothing to buy here.

claimCompany.confirmNote: This confirms access to a work mailbox, not ownership of the company. It only opens company-level aggregates.
claimCompany.publicTitle: Your public signal - what seekers see
claimCompany.thin: Below 3 verified referrers or 3 answered asks this month, every number stays hidden. The signal is earned through real replies - it cannot be bought, and it is never a ranking.
claimCompany.people: Their names, asks and chats stay private to them - companies see the count, not the people.
claimCompany.footer: Seekers are never shown to companies: no names, no resumes, no contact details. Claiming is free.
claimCompany.signin: Sign in for company access. This does not enroll you as a referrer. If you arrived from an email, reopen that link after signing in.
